stories.title: ECI delists 474 Registered Unrecognised Political Parties (22 September)
stories.body: removed for not contesting any election in the last six years.

stories.title: 56th GST Council (3–4 September, New Delhi): 12% and 28% slabs scrapped
stories.body: a two-tier structure of 5% (merit) and 18% (standard), plus a 40% demerit rate for sin/luxury goods; individual life and health insurance exempted; effective 22 September 2025 — the "GST 2.0" reform.
